remarks: Visit and experience this former model home featuring exceptional craftsmanship, designer touches, an open floor plan, and high ceilings. Step through the front porch entry onto striking hexagonal-pattern matte black tile flooring that flows seamlessly through the entryway. The main level features a bonus room—accented by a custom chevron wall covering and barn door. Continuing through the main floor, custom tile flooring extends through the dining area, gourmet kitchen, and spacious living room.
